definitions.short: properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy)
definitions.usage: aloud for joy, cry out, be joyful (greatly, make to) rejoice, (cause to) shout (for joy), (cause to) sing (aloud, for joy, out), triumph.

occurrences.englishText: Fire came out from before Yahweh, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
Rejoice, you nations, with his people,
Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before Yahweh,
the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me,
when the morning stars sang together,
For you will bless the righteous.
Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed.
Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous!
Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous!
Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad.
For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it.
To you, my strength, I will sing praises.
My soul stays close to you.
You visit the earth, and water it.
Let the peoples praise you, God.
My lips shall shout for joy!
Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep,
Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine,
Yes, the sparrow has found a home,
You have a mighty arm.
Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness,
How great are your works, Yahweh!
Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh.
Let the field and all that is in it exult!
Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth!
Let the rivers clap their hands.
Let your priests be clothed with righteousness.
I will also clothe her priests with salvation.
They will utter the memory of your great goodness,
Let the saints rejoice in honor.
Wisdom calls aloud in the street.
Beside the gates, at the entry of the city,
An evil man is snared by his sin,
Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”

Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.
These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of Yahweh. They cry aloud from the sea.
Your dead shall live.
It will blossom abundantly,
Then the lame man will leap like a deer,
Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices,
Sing, you heavens, for Yahweh has done it!
Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth!
Your watchmen lift up their voice.
Break out into joy!
“Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth;
Instead of your shame you will have double.
Behold, my servants will sing for joy of heart,
For Yahweh says,
They will come and sing in the height of Zion,
Then the heavens and the earth,
Arise, cry out in the night,
Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
